decisions.reason: It remained a standalone offering through 2024, fits the firm's core data-and-calculation platform, and in a growing market its option value still appears to exceed its carrying cost.

Its downgrade from a dedicated page to a website mention suggests weaker traction or bundling, but as a close-to-core calculator with likely low maintenance cost it is still worth keeping while demand remains uncertain.
Although it lost standalone prominence, it looks like an enabling complement to the firm's location and tariff solutions, so the firm is likely to retain it unless portfolio-pruning pressure rises.
